subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add outbound Telegram album/media-group support now, and should maintainers port the linked draft PR or choose a different message-tool API shape?
rationale: The request adds user-facing Telegram message-tool behavior and touches multiple delivery funnels, so automation should not choose the permanent API and fallback semantics while an open draft implementation already exists.

options.title: Port a current-main album implementation
options.body: Use the linked draft as input, but adapt it to current durable send, reply delivery, outbound adapter, docs, and live-proof requirements.

options.title: Keep sequential fan-out only
options.body: Treat native Telegram album grouping as not planned for now and document the supported `mediaUrls` sequential behavior before closing or superseding the draft.

options.title: Approve one surface first
options.body: Limit the first implementation to one entry point, such as `message.send`, and track reply/outbound payload album behavior separately.

recommendation.title: Port a current-main album implementation
recommendation.body: Use the linked draft as input, but adapt it to current durable send, reply delivery, outbound adapter, docs, and live-proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner already reviewed the issue and has the strongest product-routing signal across Telegram action/runtime and docs history.
